Total net sales for the four-week fiscal month increased 1.8 percent to $94.9 million compared to net sales of $93.2 million in the prior year four-week fiscal month ended November 1, 2025. articles.summary: The Buckle, Inc. (NYSE: BKE) announced today that comparable store net sales, for stores open at least one year, for the 4-week period ended October 31, 2026 decreased 0.5 percent from comparable store net sales for the 4-week period ended November 1, 2025. Net sales for the 4-week fiscal month ended October 31, 2026 increased 1.8 percent to $94.9 million from net sales of $93.2 million for the prior year 4-week fiscal month ended November 1, 2025. Comparable store net sales for the 13-week third quarter ended October 31, 2026 increased 0.6 percent from comparable store net sales for the 13-week period ended November 1, 2025. Net sales for the 13-week fiscal third quarter ended October 31, 2026 increased 2.6 percent to $329.2 million compared to net sales of $320.8 million for the prior year 13-week fiscal third quarter ended November 1, 2025.
